decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board early on with cards like Thoughtseize, Fatal Push, and Bitter Triumph while using aggressive creatures like Faerie Miscreant and Floodpits Drowner to pressure the opponent. Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide powerful late-game threats. The deck also aims to control the board through cards like Moon-Circuit Hacker and Mockingbird. The mana base is designed to support both black and blue mana sources efficiently, allowing for smooth gameplay and flexibility in casting spells.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources and disrupting their game plan through hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay. The main win condition is to outvalue the opponent with powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse while maintaining board control. The inclusion of land cards that provide additional utility, such as Unholy Annex / Ritual Chamber and Boseiju, Who Endures, adds versatility to the deck's game plan. The deck aims to grind out a victory through attrition and resource management.

The main concept of this Dimir Aggro deck is to control the game through disruption and removal spells like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push, while also putting pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Kaito, Bane of Nightmares and Moon-Circuit Hacker. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of card advantage and efficient threats, utilizing cards like Faerie Miscreant and Floodpits Drowner to maintain board presence. Additionally, the deck includes bomb cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to provide a powerful late-game threat. The deck's mana base prioritizes consistency and flexibility, allowing for a smooth curve of spells.

The main goal of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 Aggro deck is to overwhelm opponents with a combination of powerful creatures and instant/sorcery spells. By utilizing cards like Gran-Gran and Firebending Lesson to deal damage quickly, as well as Divide by Zero and Jeskai Revelation to control the board and draw cards for consistency, this deck aims to continuously apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With a combination of aggression and card advantage, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents to secure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo to overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards that support this combo such as Multiversal Passage and Formidable Speaker. The deck also includes control elements like Thoughtseize and Bitter Triumph to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, it includes cards for card advantage like Professor of Symbology and Cache Grab. The key strategy is to efficiently set up the combo while controlling the game with disruption and card advantage. Ultimately, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and combo interactions.

The main concept of this deck is to create a powerful synergy between Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II, utilizing cards like Thundering Broodwagon and Thoughtseize to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. Agadeem's Awakening and Cache Grab provide additional resources and graveyard recursion, while Formidable Speaker and Esika's Chariot help to generate value and tempo. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with creature power and resilience, while also having the flexibility to adapt to various matchups through its diverse selection of cards.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly build up a board presence with low-cost, aggressive creatures like Soul-Scar Mage and Monastery Swiftspear, while using burn spells like Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage to control the opponent's board and finish them off quickly. The deck also includes cards like Stormchaser's Talent and Flow State to give the creatures additional abilities and speed up the game. The mana base is designed to support the fast tempo of the deck, focusing on generating red mana for burn spells and blue mana for card draw and counter magic.

The main focus of this deck is to control the pace of the game through various means such as counterspells, removal, and card advantage. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional value through blinking permanents. The deck aims to stall the game until it can establish a dominant board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and threats. The mana base is optimized for consistency and the deck includes a variety of versatile cards to handle different situations effectively.

The main concept of this Arclight Phoenix Aggro deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with instants and sorceries using cards like Consider, Opt, and Treasure Cruise, in order to reanimate Arclight Phoenix multiple times throughout the game. Cards like Artist's Talent and Picklock Prankster help to further fuel the graveyard while dealing damage to the opponent. Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse provide removal and deck manipulation, while Into the Flood Maw and Flashback offer additional ways to bring back Arclight Phoenix. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of card advantage, efficient creatures, and burn spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing green devotion to generate mana and power up cards like Craterhoof Behemoth and Quantum Riddler for a strong aggro strategy. It includes cards like Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx to ramp up mana quickly, while also including cards like Shang-Chi, Master of Kung Fu and Badgermole Cub for aggressive creature plays. The deck also includes protection and card draw options with cards like Enduring Vitality and Boseiju, Who Endures to support the aggressive playstyle.

The main concept of this Pioneer 1 vs 1 control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan while slowly building up a strong board presence. It focuses on removal spells like Abrupt Decay and Fatal Push to deal with threats, along with hand disruption like Thoughseize and Duress. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to pressure the opponent. The mana base includes lands that provide utility and flexibility, such as Boseiju, Who Endures and Mutavault. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a grindy game.

This aggressive deck focuses on building a strong board presence with human creatures and pumping them up with anthems and pump effects. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a mix of powerful creatures like Adeline, Thalia's Lieutenant, and Basri, Tomorrow's Champion. The inclusion of Mox Amber and Queen of Dale allows for explosive starts and the ability to generate additional resources. Declaration in Stone provides removal against opposing threats while the mana base supports the human tribal theme with Eiganjo, Cavern of Souls, and Mutavault.

Utilizing graveyard recursion and milling effects, this deck aims to quickly fill the graveyard with creatures like Bloodghast, Prized Amalgam, and Narcomoeba in order to trigger powerful abilities and overwhelm the opponent. Founding the Third Path and Practiced Offense provide additional ways to manipulate the graveyard, while Breaking / Entering and Creeping Chill offer alternate win conditions. Otherworldly Gaze and Say Its Name help to dig for key cards, while Witherbloom Command provides flexibility. Altanak, the Thrice-Called offers a powerful late-game threat. The mana base includes a mix of lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures, backed up by a mix of burn spells and card draw. By playing fast and applying pressure early in the game, the deck aims to keep opponents on the back foot and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. Key cards such as Monastery Swiftspear, Soul-Scar Mage, and Stormchaser's Talent help to chip away at the opponent's life total while Burst Lightning and Reckless Rage provide efficient removal. This deck thrives on speed and efficiency to secure victory.

This Izzet Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while maintaining card advantage and flexibility in spells. With a mix of removal, counterspells, and card draw, the deck aims to control the board and outvalue the opponent. Using powerful instant and sorcery spells, along with efficient creatures like Hearth Elemental and Eddymurk Crab, the deck can apply pressure while disrupting the opponent's strategy. The mana base supports the dual-color requirements of the deck, allowing for consistent casting of spells and creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy using a combination of hand disruption spells like Thoughtseize and Duress, along with removal spells like Fatal Push and Abrupt Decay. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistent access to the deck's key cards, allowing for a strong and consistent control strategy.
